name: Tony_Fan_Purchase_Request
_about: Spec v1.4 SP-R1 (review C11): the supplier never sees our selling price (SRP). The copy used to carry SRP_Rate_PR_Supplier2 only so the portal could tell that a reference price exists. It now carries this yes / no flag instead and never the amount.

fields.name: Ref_Price_Known_Supplier2
fields.label: Reference price known
fields.helpText: Yes = we already hold a reference price for this item, so a Confirmed answer may skip the initial price. Never the amount.
